args.body: Review the two prepared dossiers in products/services/diversified-offers/prospect-offers.json against their saved primary sources. Prepare one operator authorization batch with the exact messages and routes; do not send. DigitalPress is general support, not a supplier invitation, and its recipient requires normal public-page inspection. The content-management offer deliberately narrows an advertised role; confirm that distinction and unavailable authorized Reddit account. No new samples, Pointer follow-up, accounts or purchases. Payment compatibility and paid acceptance remain separate dependencies. Preserve existing retirements.

description: Prepared and read two sourced, AI-disclosed offer dossiers in products/services/diversified-offers/prospect-offers.json: DigitalPress documentation QA at CAD40 and an offline content-inventory pilot at CAD25. Verified public support activity and an explicit content-management request justify these inquiries; willingness to buy the proposed scopes remains unverified. Contact routes, exact messages, effort, payment dependencies and profitability limits are documented. Nothing sent or earned. Three unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown. Existing retirement obligations remain unchanged.
